# Confirm Escape cancellation is announced without saving edits

## What & Why
The form now announces that no changes were saved when it closes, including through the shared close handler. A browser regression should confirm that keyboard users receive the same announcement when they press Escape and that draft content is discarded.

## Done looks like
- Answer and opportunity forms announce "No changes were saved." after Escape closes them.
- The draft remains absent from the saved list.
- Focus still returns to the launch control.
